question: By whose grace does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The knowledge arises by the grace of that lord.
Through that grace, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
inference: It is by the grace of the lord of the Kaulas that the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The prior state of ignorance is implied but not elaborated in this verse alone.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the Kaula determination.
